def: Searching over the text of prompts, and the examples included in them, to maximise a metric measured on a development set.
A prompt optimiser in which a language model carries out the steps of a genetic algorithm or differential evolution on a population of prompts.
Optimization by PROmpting: a model is shown earlier candidate prompts with their scores and asked to propose a better one.
A prompt-evolution method that also evolves the mutation-prompts that rewrite the task prompts.
An instruction that tells a model how to rewrite a task prompt, which can itself be evolved.
A process whose improvement step is among the things it improves, such as a search that evolves its own mutation operators.
A framework in which an LLM pipeline is written as modules with signatures and an optimiser generates their prompts and examples against a metric.
A declaration of what a DSPy module takes in and returns, without the wording of the prompt.
A DSPy optimiser that proposes instructions and chooses demonstrations jointly, using mini-batch scores to guide the search.
A prompt optimiser that reflects on trajectories in natural language and keeps a Pareto frontier of candidate prompts.
The examples a search uses to choose among candidates, kept separate from the test set that is used once to report the result.
